title: Agentic Construction of EPAR-Structured Toxicity Dossiers: Split Evaluation and a Rapamycin Case Study

contributions.purpose: 用代理直接按 EPAR 监管结构生成安全档案
contributions.mechanism: 代理将安全信息写入 EPAR/SmPC schema(structured-from-start),映射 MedDRA PT/SOC
contributions.evaluation: 生成 §4.8 结构化档案(定性,可跨药比较)
contributions.domain: 药物安全 / 监管文档自动化
contributions.source_quote: Structured from the start: the agent writes into a regulator-style layout so outputs are easy to navigate and comparable across drugs.

contributions.purpose: 提供无歧义打分的拆分评估协议
contributions.mechanism: '一句一副作用' 拆分,与官方 leaflet preferred terms 一对一匹配并核验引用
contributions.evaluation: split evaluation 协议(term/SOC macro/加权覆盖 + citation accuracy)
contributions.source_quote: One claim = one side effect: we split sentences so each claim contains exactly one side-effect term for unambiguous scoring.

contributions.purpose: 在 rapamycin 上证明优于网络基线
contributions.mechanism: 对比 web-enabled LLM 基线在 sirolimus §4.8 的覆盖与引用准确率
contributions.source_quote: On sirolimus, our approach covers more of the leaflet's terms than a strong web-enabled baseline while keeping good citation accuracy.

contributions.mechanism: 公开三份 CSV + 一键重建脚本,可在他人代理上复跑
contributions.evaluation: 数据表 + recipe(单脚本从 3 个 CSV 重建全部图表)
contributions.source_quote: We release tables, figures, and a simple recipe so others can repeat the evaluation on their own agents.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Baseline. A general-purpose, web-enabled LLM prompted to "search and compile side effects of a specific substance (e.g., sirolimus)" without EPAR schema enforcement, SOC mapping, split...

notes: 数据红旗:n=1 药物(仅 sirolimus)case study,样本极小——部分 SOC 仅 n=1(Investigations/Musculoskel./Renal 等),置信区间极宽(term 48.4–82.8);第 2 节标题自曝 '(Progress Report)',属阶段性/未完成工作;decision=desk-reject。评估仅单药,泛化性无从判断。
